title: feat(plugin-list): TabBar component for ListView multi-tab view switching with console integration
body:
`ViewTabSchema` types exist but no tab UI renders. This adds a `TabBar` component that renders above the ListView toolbar, with active tab state management and filter switching on tab change, fully integrated into the console app.

### New: `TabBar` component (`packages/plugin-list/src/components/TabBar.tsx`)
- Controlled/uncontrolled active tab state; auto-selects `isDefault` tab
- `pinned` tabs always visible regardless of `visible` flag
- Lucide icon resolution from kebab-case names
- Order-based sorting, `visible: 'false' | false` filtering
- ARIA: `role="tablist"` / `role="tab"` / `aria-selected`

### ListView integration
- Replaces inline tab rendering with `TabBar`
- `handleTabChange` applies tab's `filter` config to `currentFilters` state and fires `onFilterChange`
- Filter IDs scoped per tab (`tab-filter-${tab.name}`)

### Console & plugin-view integration
- `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` — `renderContent` schema now propagates `tabs` from schema level to ListView
- `apps/console/src/components/ObjectView.tsx` — `renderListView` fullSchema now propagates `tabs` from listSchema
- Full data flow: `ObjectViewSchema.tabs` → PluginObjectView `renderContent` → Console `renderListView` → `ListView` → `TabBar`

### i18n
- `list.tabs` and `list.allRecords` keys added to all 10 locale files + fallback translations

### Usage
```tsx
<ListView
  schema={{
    type: 'list-view',
    objectName: 'contacts',
    viewType: 'grid',
    fields: ['name', 'email', 'status'],
    tabs: [
      { name: 'all', label: 'All', isDefault: true },
      { name: 'active', label: 'Active', icon: 'circle-check', filter: { logic: 'and', conditions: [{ field: 'status', operator: 'eq', value: 'active' }] } },
      { name: 'vip', label: 'VIP', pinned: true, icon: 'star' },
    ],
  }}
  onFilterChange={(filters) => console.log(filters)}
/>
```

### Tests
- 17 new TabBar unit tests covering rendering, state, pinned visibility, order sorting, icons, ARIA, controlled mode, and filter propagation
- 1 new integration test in `config-sync-integration.test.tsx` verifying tabs propagation through `renderListView`
- All 109 existing ListView tests and 23 console ObjectView tests pass unchanged
